title: Ticket stub
brief: A cinema ticket with round notches where the stub tears off along a dashed perforation, and an Add to wallet button on the stub.

inspiration.note: Took the notch where the stub meets the main body and the dashed tear line; the colours, copy and button are ours.
Looked at how small flat cards keep one accent colour; we limited the ticket to ink, cream and one rust kicker.
